experiments.name: Pirate Face model resilience
experiments.why: Test whether Pirate Face can provide a verifiable fallback distribution path for a pinned open-weight model artifact without adding a production runtime dependency.
experiments.next_action: Keep Pirate Face as an optional last-resort path only: record a magnet and canonical SHA-256 manifest with any model pin and verify hashes after a fallback retrieval; do not add production routing, a registry, or seeding infrastructure.
experiments.result_summary: PASS: the pinned sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 artifact (revision 1110a243fdf4706b3f48f1d95db1a4f5529b4d41, Apache-2.0) was retrieved through the Pirate Face magnet and verified byte-for-byte - 29/29 payload files with matching SHA-256 including model.safetensors - with the Hugging Face zone and Pirate Face web layer blocked, and again with the Pirate Face tracker blocked (DHT only). Caveat: the torrent omits .gitattributes, so full repository snapshot identity is not exact while the model payload is exact. No production change, no registry, no new infrastructure.
